reason: This text fragment (Exodus 2:11-15) describes purely narrative events: Moses witnessing an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, Moses killing the Egyptian, Moses fleeing Egypt when Pharaoh seeks his death. The passage contains no mention of Yahweh (God) whatsoever, nor any divine action, statement, or attitude toward the Hebrew people. The antagonism described is from Pharaoh against Moses, not from Yahweh against the Hebrew people. The statement cannot apply to a text that does not depict or mention Yahweh's actions or stance at all.
